summary:
Iter92 frontend verification of Oct-2026 hourly-wager rules + A-Z one-per-line WhatsApp absent lists. All four reviewer requirements verified end-to-end against the live preview (https://youth-regatta-app.preview.emergentagent.com). (1) AbsentDispatchPrompt on /admin: clicked data-testid='absent-dispatch-send' with window.open intercepted — captured wa.me text contained the header '❗ *Absent (no info)* (91):' followed by 91 bullet lines '• Name', each on its own line, case-insensitive A-Z sorted (verified lines==sorted(lines) by lower()); a second '📝 *On leave* (1):
• MAHESH KUMAR A' section was also one-per-line; NO comma-joined name list in the WhatsApp message (regex ':\s*[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+,' = no match). The modal's in-DOM PREVIEW still shows names comma-joined (AbsentDispatchPrompt.jsx L116/L120/L123/L126 — slate text) but the actual outgoing WA message is what the spec cares about and it is correct. (2) DailyRosterShareButton on /muster: clicked data-testid='daily-roster-share-whatsapp-btn' — captured message '📋 Today's Staff & Coach Roster — Wed 7 Oct' with '🏖️ On Leave (1):
• MAHESH KUMAR A — till Wed 7 Oct' and '❌ Not in / Reason unknown (91):
• Admin Two Test
• AINUL HAQUE
...' blocks — bullets=True, comma_names=False, every multi-line block sorted A-Z (keys stripped of ' — till …' tail). (3) AbsentShareBanner on /muster: did not render in this preview because /api/muster/absent-report has nothing after the daily cutoff (component correctly returns null when n==0 — buildAbsentMessage code itself uses sortByName and '• ' bullets, visually inspected). (4) SelfCheckIn hourly-wager isolation: created throwaway staff member via POST /api/members {email: test_<hex>@ishowedup-test.example.com, role:'member', category:'staff', hourly_wager:true, work_start:'00:00', work_end:'23:59', password}; after /api/rules/accept + /api/attendance/geo-toggle (check-in via API) → /self-checkin rendered checked-in-hero but NEITHER data-testid='ot-reason' NOR 'early-out-reason' appeared (counts 0/0). Comparison: an identical SALARIED member (hourly_wager:false, same 00:00-23:59 window) on the same page rendered early-out-reason=1 — confirming the hourly early-return in SelfCheckIn.jsx otInfo/earlyOutInfo useMemos works. Member(s) deleted via DELETE /api/members/{id}, cleanup confirmed 200. (5) Grid at /admin/reports (The Grid, Calendar Grid tab): all three live hourly members scanned via DOM tr walker (104 rows) — Ganesh Peerkatla (row 13), Ravali Parandi (row 58), Vaishnavi Veeravamsham (row 100) ALL have hasAB=false (zero 'AB' cells across the 31-day grid), while salaried rows (Admin Two Test row 1, Campus Administrator row 6, Coach Test row 8) show the expected 'AB AB AB AB AB' sequence of past non-present days. Hourly OT H column shows '8h' (cap verified). All frontend requirements satisfied.

issues: In-DOM list preview inside the modal (lines 115/119/122/125 of components/AbsentDispatchPrompt.jsx) still comma-joins the names via `d.allAbsent.join(', ')` etc. The WhatsApp message that is actually sent IS one-per-line (correct per spec), but if an admin reads the modal preview before tapping Send they see a comma list. Low priority — spec only mandates the WhatsApp text format, which is correct.

action_items: OPTIONAL (consistency, not spec-blocking): also render the modal body preview of components/AbsentDispatchPrompt.jsx as a one-per-line bulleted list so the admin sees the same shape they're about to send.

SPEC CHECK (please confirm): Grid 'Payable DAYS' total for an hourly member who was present on 1 day shows 1 for Ganesh Peerkatla, not 0. The spec says 'Grid totals payable/absent/lop/late/early_out/dar_missed = 0 for them'. absent/lop/late/early_out/dar_missed ARE all 0/blank (verified). But the Payable count = 1 (matches the single 'P' cell). If 'payable=0' in the spec means 'payable DAYS column = 0 regardless of actual attendance', then grid.py `_absent_or_blank` zeroing isn't enough — also need to zero the payable_days total for hourly rows. If 'payable=0' only means 'payable AMOUNT = 0' (which the Pay column shows), then current behaviour is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/AbsentDispatchPrompt.jsx — buildMessage() correctly uses sortByName + '• ' per line for every section (Absent / On leave / On tour / LOP). Verified in prod WA capture: 91 absent names, 1 on-leave name, all sorted case-insensitive A-Z. The modal body itself still comma-joins, which is cosmetic.

frontend/src/pages/muster/AbsentShareBanner.jsx — buildAbsentMessage() uses sortByName(r.athletes) and sortByName(r.coaches) with '• ' per line. Component wasn't rendered in preview (empty report) but code is correct.

frontend/src/pages/muster/DailyRosterShareButton.jsx — buildRosterMessage() sorts each section via sortByName(arr, p=>p.name) with '• ' per line (plus ' — till <date>' suffix for leaves). Verified in prod WA capture.

frontend/src/pages/SelfCheckIn.jsx — otInfo useMemo short-circuits on `user?.hourly_wager` (L299) and earlyOutInfo useMemo short-circuits on `user?.hourly_wager` (L328). Verified by A/B comparison: hourly=0/0 prompts, salaried-with-same-hours=0/1 prompts.

backend/routes/reports/grid.py — AB cells correctly cleared for hourly rows (observed on Ganesh/Ravali/Vaishnavi; 0 AB cells across 31 days). Possible gap: Payable DAYS total column still counts actual present days for hourly rows (Ganesh=1) — see action_items 'SPEC CHECK'.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only pass; backend hourly rules 6/6 per prior report)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 4 reviewer-requested checks (AbsentDispatchPrompt WA fmt, DailyRosterShareButton WA fmt, Self-Check-in hourly skip, Grid no-AB-for-hourly). AbsentShareBanner not exercised (empty report) but code is correct by inspection.

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345. Throwaway hourly staff created and deleted via POST/DELETE /api/members. Rules-accept endpoint is POST /api/rules/accept (404 on all other guessed paths).
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED one hourly throwaway (test_<hex>@ishowedup-test.example.com) and one salaried throwaway (same email prefix). Both checked-in and checked-out via API, then DELETE /api/members/{id} returned 200. Also cleaned up a leftover test_d6e01db5@ from a prior interrupted run. No real-member data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Grid route is /admin/reports (NOT /admin/grid). AbsentDispatchPrompt shows only when device hour>=10 AND today has absents/leaves/tours — if testing in UTC before 10:00, use `page.add_init_script` to override Date.prototype.getHours BEFORE any script runs (patching after mount won't fire the component because its useCallback(evaluate) closes over the earlier value). Capture WhatsApp output by monkey-patching window.open in an add_init_script so each wa.me / web.whatsapp.com URL is pushed into window.__waUrls — the message is in the ?text= query param (URL-decoded). The modal body preview still comma-joins, which is cosmetic; the spec is about the WhatsApp message. Throwaway hourly test members: POST /api/members then POST /api/rules/accept (NOT /api/me/accept-rules — that returns 404) before trying to check in via UI (otherwise /self-checkin redirects to /attendance-rules). To force a check-in without GPS: POST /api/attendance/geo-toggle {latitude:0,longitude:0} with the member's Bearer token — the server records it with geo_unavailable=true. Clean up with DELETE /api/members/{id} as admin.
rca of the issue: N/A — iter92 is a verification pass. All four reviewer requirements for the Oct-2026 hourly-wager / A-Z one-per-line WhatsApp list rules behave as specified. One optional cosmetic deviation (modal body preview still comma-joined) and one spec clarification needed (Grid Payable DAYS count for hourly rows) are documented under action_items.
